handlePlayCampaignCalendarInit(HttpExchange exchange, String campaignId) throws IOException {\n        User user = authenticate(exchange);\n        if (user == null) {\n            unauthorized(exchange);\n            return;\n        }\n        Map<String, Object> campaign = storage.getPlayCampaign(campaignId);\n        if (campaign == null) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 404, ERROR_CAMPAIGN_NOT_FOUND);\n            return;\n        }\n        if (!\"dm\".equals(user.role) || !user.username.equals(campaign.get(\"owner\"))) {\n            forbidden(exchange);\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            String body = HttpSupport.readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = JsonUtils.parseJsonObject(body);\n            Object dayObj = req.get(\"day\");\n            String season = (String) req.get(\"season\");\n            if (dayObj == null || season == null || season.isEmpty()) {\n                throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing fields\");\n            }\n            int day = JsonUtils.toInt(dayObj);\n            if (day < 1) throw new RuntimeException(\"Invalid day\");\n            if (!isValidSeason(season)) throw new RuntimeException(\"Invalid season\");\n            if (storage.getPlayCampaignCalendar(campaignId) != null) {\n                HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 409, ERROR_CALENDAR_EXISTS);\n                return;\n            }\n            if (!storage.insertPlayCampaignCalendar(campaignId, day, season)) {\n                HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 409, ERROR_CALENDAR_EXISTS);\n                return;\n            }\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 201, calendarJson(day, season));\n        } catch (RuntimeException e) {\n            badRequest(exchange);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void handlePlayCampaignCalendarGet(HttpExchange exchange, String campaignId) throws IOException {\n        User user = authenticate(exchange);\n        if (user == null) {\n            unauthorized(exchange);\n            return;\n        }\n        Map<String, Object> campaign = storage.getPlayCampaign(campaignId);\n        if (campaign == null) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 404, ERROR_CAMPAIGN_NOT_FOUND);\n            return;\n        }\n        boolean forbidden(exchange);\n            return;\n        }\n        Map<String, Object> calendar = storage.getPlayCampaignCalendar(campaignId);\n        if (calendar == null) {\n \"spring\".equals(season) || \"summer\".equals(season) || \"autumn\".equals(season) || \"winter\".equals(season);\n    }\n\n    private String computeWeather(String season, int day) {\n        int offset;\n        if (\"spring\".equals(season)) offset = 0;\n        else if (\"summer\".equals(season)) offset = 1;\n        else if (\"autumn\".equals(season)) offset = 2;\n        else offset = 3;\n        int value = (day + offset) % 4;\n        if (value == 0) return \"clear\";\n        if (value == 1) return \"rain\";\n        if (value == 2) return \"wind\";\n        return \"snow\";\n    }\n\n    private String calendarJson(int day, String season) {\n        Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        res.put(\"day\", day);\n        res.put(\"season\", season);\n JsonUtils.toInt(row.get(\"dex\")), JsonUtils.toInt(row.get(\"roll\"))));\n            }\n\n            CombatSession session = new CombatSession((String) sessionRow.get(\"id\"), combatants);\n            session.round = JsonUtils.toInt(sessionRow.get(\"round\"));\n            session.turnIndex = JsonUtils.toInt(sessionRow.get(\"turn_index\"));\n\n            List<Map<String, Object>> conditionRows = query(\"SELECT target, condition, remaining_rounds FROM conditions WHERE session_id = \" + quote(id) + \" ORDER BY id;\");\n            for (Map<String, Object> row : conditionRows) {\n                String target = (String) row.get(\"target\");\n                session.conditions.computeIfAbsent(target, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(new Condition((String) row.get(\"condition\"), JsonUtils.toInt(row.get(\"remaining_rounds\"))));\n            }\n\n            return session;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public void addCondition(String sessionId, String target, String condition, int duration) {\n        synchronized (lock) {\n            execSql(\"INSERT INTO conditions (session_id, target, condition, remaining_rounds) VALUES (\" + quote(sessionId) + \", \" + quote(target) + \", List<String> sqls = new ArrayList<>();\n            sqls.add(\"BEGIN;\");\n            sqls.add(\"UPDATE combat_sessions SET round = \" + session.round + \", turn_index = \" + session.turnIndex + \" WHERE id = \" + quote(session.id) + \";\");\n            sqls.add(\"UPDATE conditions SET remaining_rounds = remaining_rounds - 1 WHERE session_id = \" + quote(session.id) + \" AND target = \" + quote(active.name) + \";\");\n            sqls.add(\"DELETE FROM conditions WHERE session_id = \" + quote(session.id) + \" AND target = \" + quote(active.name) + \" AND remaining_rounds <= 0;\");\n            sqls.add(\"COMMIT;\");\n            execSql(sqls.toArray(new String[0]));\n        }\n    }\n\n    public boolean insertMonster(String slug, String name, String cr, int armorClass, int       synchronized (lock) {\n            List<Map<String, Object>> fromRows = query(\"SELECT gold FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND character_id = \" + quote(fromCharacterId) + \";\");\n            if (fromRows.isEmpty()) return null;\n            List<Map<String, Object>> toRows = query(\"SELECT gold FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND character_id = \" + quote(toCharacterId) + \";\");\n            if (toRows.isEmpty()) throw new RuntimeException(\"Destination character not found\");\n\n            int fromGold = JsonUtils.toInt(fromRows.get(0).get(\"gold\"));\n            int toGold = JsonUtils.toInt(toRows.get(0).get(\"gold\"));\n            if (fromGold < gold) return null;\n\n            int fromGoldAfter = fromGold - gold;\n            int toGoldAfter = toGold + gold;\n            int transferId = queryCount(\"SELECT COALESCE(MAX(transfer_id), 0) AS c FROM play_campaign_transfers WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \";\") + 1;\n\n            List<String> sqls = new ArrayList<>();\n            sqls.add(\"BEGIN;\");\n            sqls.add(\"UPDATE play_campaign_members SET gold = \" + fromGoldAfter + \" WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND character_id = \" + quote(fromCharacterId) + \";\");\n            sqls.add(\"UPDATE play_campaign_members SET gold = \" + toGoldAfter + \" WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND character_id = \" + quote(toCharacterId) + \";\");\n            sqls.add(\"INSERT INTO play_campaign_transfers (campaign_id, transfer_id, from_character_id, to_character_id, gold) VALUES (\" + quote(campaignId) + \", \" + transferId + \", \" + quote(fromCharacterId) + \", \" + quote(toCharacterId) + \", \" + gold + \");\");\n            sqls.add(\"COMMIT;\");\n            execSql(sqls.toArray(new String[0]));\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"from_character_id\", fromCharacterId);\n            res.put(\"to_character_id\", toCharacterId);\n            res.put(\"gold\", gold);\n            res.put(\"from_gold\", fromGoldAfter);\n            res.put(\"to_gold\", toGoldAfter);\n            res.put(\"transfer_id\", transferId);\n            return res;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public boolean insertPlayCampaignLoot(String FROM play_campaign_loot_votes WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND loot_id = \" + quote(lootId) + \" GROUP BY recipient_character_id ORDER BY c DESC, recipient_character_id;\");\n            if (voteRows.isEmpty()) return null;\n            int topCount = JsonUtils.toInt(voteRows.get(0).get(\"c\"));\n            String winner = (String)             \"UPDATE play_campaign_loot SET status = 'assigned', recipient_character_id = \" + quote(winner) + \", votes = \" + topCount + \" WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND       synchronized (lock) {\n            List<Map<String, Object>> fromRows = query(\"SELECT gold FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND character_id = \" + quote(fromCharacterId) + \";\");\n            if (fromRows.isEmpty()) return null;\n            List<Map<String, Object>> toRows = query(\"SELECT gold FROM play_campaign_members WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND character_id = \" + quote(toCharacterId) + \";\");\n            if (toRows.isEmpty()) throw new RuntimeException(\"Destination character not found\");\n\n            int fromGold = JsonUtils.toInt(fromRows.get(0).get(\"gold\"));\n            int toGold = JsonUtils.toInt(toRows.get(0).get(\"gold\"));\n            if (fromGold < gold) return null;\n\n            int fromGoldAfter = fromGold - gold;\n            int toGoldAfter = toGold + gold;\n            int transferId = queryCount(\"SELECT COALESCE(MAX(transfer_id), 0) AS c FROM play_campaign_transfers WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \";\") + 1;\n\n            List<String> sqls = new ArrayList<>();\n            sqls.add(\"BEGIN;\");\n            sqls.add(\"UPDATE play_campaign_members SET gold = \" + fromGoldAfter + \" WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND character_id = \" + quote(fromCharacterId) + \";\");\n            sqls.add(\"UPDATE play_campaign_members SET gold = \" + toGoldAfter + \" WHERE campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND character_id = \" + quote(toCharacterId) + \";\");\n            sqls.add(\"INSERT INTO play_campaign_transfers (campaign_id, transfer_id, from_character_id, to_character_id, gold) VALUES (\" + quote(campaignId) + \", \" + transferId + \", \" + quote(fromCharacterId) + \", \" + quote(toCharacterId) + \", \" + gold + \");\");\n            sqls.add(\"COMMIT;\");\n            execSql(sqls.toArray(new String[0]));\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"from_character_id\", fromCharacterId);\n            res.put(\"to_character_id\", toCharacterId);\n            res.put(\"gold\", gold);\n            res.put(\"from_gold\", fromGoldAfter);\n            res.put(\"to_gold\", toGoldAfter);\n            res.put(\"transfer_id\", transferId);\n            return res;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public boolean insertPlayCampaignLoot(String background == null || background.isEmpty()) {\n                throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing fields\");\n            }\n            if (!Rules.VALID_RACES.contains(race.toLowerCase())\n                    || !Rules.VALID_CLASSES.contains(className.toLowerCase())\n                    || !Rules.VALID_BACKGROUNDS.contains(background.toLowerCase())) {\n                throw new JsonUtils.toInt(val);\n                if (score < 1 || score > 30) throw new RuntimeException(\"Ability out of range\");\n                if (\"con\".equals(name)) conScore = score;\n            }\n            int level = 1;\n            int hpMax = Rules.hitDieAtLevel1(className) + Rules.abilityModifier(conScore);\n            if (hpMax < 1) hpMax = 1;\n            String abilitiesJson = background);\n            res.put(\"level\", level);\n            res.put(\"hp_max\", hpMax);\n            res.put(\"proficiency_bonus\", Rules.proficiencyBonus(level));\n null) {\n            unauthorized(exchange);\n            return;\n        }\n        String owner = storage.getPlayCampaignCharacterOwner(campaignId, charId);\n        if (owner == null) {\n            notFound(exchange);\n            return;\n        }\n        if (!user.username.equals(owner)) {\n            forbidden(exchange);\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            String body = HttpSupport.readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = JsonUtils.parseJsonObject(body);\n            String race = (String) req.get(\"race\");\n            String className = (String) req.get(\"class\");\n            String background = (String) req.get(\"background\");\n            if (race == null || race.isEmpty() || className == null || className.isEmpty() || background == null || background.isEmpty()) {\n                throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing fields\");\n            }\n            if (!Rules.VALID_RACES.contains(race.toLowerCase())\n                    || !Rules.VALID_CLASSES.contains(className.toLowerCase())\n                    || !Rules.VALID_BACKGROUNDS.contains(background.toLowerCase())) {\n                throw new RuntimeException(\"Invalid choice\");\n            }\n            Map<String, Object> abilities = (Map<String, Object>) req.get(\"abilities\");\n            if (abilities == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing abilities\");\n            String[] abilityNames = {\"str\", \"dex\", \"con\", \"int\", \"wis\", \"cha\"};\n            int conScore = 0;\n            for (String name : abilityNames) {\n                Object val = abilities.get(name);\n                if (val == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing ability: \" + name);\n                int score = JsonUtils.toInt(val);\n                if (score < 1 || score > 30) throw new RuntimeException(\"Ability out of range\");\n                if (\"con\".equals(name)) conScore = score;\n            }\n            int level = 1;\n            int hpMax = Rules.hitDieAtLevel1(className) + Rules.abilityModifier(conScore);\n            if (hpMax < 1) hpMax = 1;\n            String abilitiesJson = JsonUtils.toJson(abilities);\n            storage.updatePlayCampaignCharacterBuild(campaignId, charId, race, className, background, level, hpMax, abilitiesJson);\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"character_id\", charId);\n            res.put(\"race\", race);\n            res.put(\"class\", className);\n            res.put(\"background\", background);\n            res.put(\"level\", level);\n            res.put(\"hp_max\", hpMax);\n            res.put(\"proficiency_bonus\", Rules.proficiencyBonus(level));\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 200, JsonUtils.toJson(res));\n        } catch (RuntimeException e) {\n            badRequest(exchange);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void handlePlayCampaignCharacterLevelUp(HttpExchange exchange, String campaignId, String charId) throws IOException {\n        User user = authenticate(exchange);\n        if (user == null) {\n            unauthorized(exchange);\n            return;\n        }\n        Map<String, Object> campaign = storage.getPlayCampaign(campaignId);\n        if (campaign == null) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 404, ERROR_CAMPAIGN_NOT_FOUND);\n            return;\n        }\n        String owner = storage.getPlayCampaignCharacterOwner(campaignId, charId);\n        if (owner {\n            String body = HttpSupport.readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = JsonUtils.parseJsonObject(body);\n            Object levelObj = req.get(\"level\");\n            if (levelObj == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing level\");\n            int requestedLevel = JsonUtils.toInt(levelObj);\n            Map<String, Object> info = storage.getPlayCampaignCharacterLevelInfo(campaignId, charId);\n            if (info == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Character not found\");\n            int currentLevel = JsonUtils.toInt(info.get(\"level\"));\n            if (requestedLevel != currentLevel + 1) throw new RuntimeException(\"Invalid level\");\n            String className = (String) = JsonUtils.parseJsonObject(abilitiesJson);\n                Object conObj = abilities.get(\"con\");\n                if (conObj != null) conModifier = Rules.abilityModifier(JsonUtils.toInt(conObj));\n            }\n            int hitDie = Rules.hitDieAtLevel1(className);\n            int average = hitDie / 2 + 1;\n            int newHpMax = currentHpMax + average + conModifier;\n            if (newHpMax < 1) newHpMax = 1;\n            if (!storage.levelUpPlayCampaignCharacter(campaignId, charId, requestedLevel, newHpMax)) {\n                throw new RuntimeException(\"Level up failed\");\n            }\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"character_id\", charId);\n Rules.proficiencyBonus(requestedLevel));\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 200, JsonUtils.toJson(res));\n        } catch (RuntimeException e) {\n            badRequest(exchange);\n
